src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-I Village Horticulture Assi

x: Phishing uses deceptive e-mails or texts asking you to install software or reveal personal information.

Arrest made by police when the accused is granted anticipatory bail by courts

src: APPSC AEE General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023

src: APPSC Assistant Social, BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Mains P

s: Right to Privacy is contained in:
